entities.summary: Karin Wahlberg is a Swedish obstetrician and author. She is most famous for her crime series about Criminal Inspector Claes Claesson and his wife Veronika Lundborg, chief physician at Oskarshamn Hospital. In 2012 her authorship was introduced to America. Her work has been likened to the traditional detective fiction of Agatha Christie.
